symptom: PC in VLAN 30 cannot reach server
topology: PC connected to access switch in VLAN 30; server is in VLAN 20
expected_root_cause: Required VLAN or VLAN path is missing
evidence: show vlan brief: VLAN 30 missing
recommended_action: Verify VLAN configuration and trunk path

symptom: Users in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with VLAN 30
topology: Two access VLANs require inter-VLAN routing
evidence: show vlan brief shows VLAN 20 and VLAN 30; no routing evidence
recommended_action: Verify Layer 3 VLAN gateway configuration

symptom: New VLAN users have no network connectivity
topology: Access switch has ports assigned to a new VLAN
expected_root_cause: VLAN is not present on switch
evidence: show vlan brief does not contain required VLAN
recommended_action: Create or verify the required VLAN configuration

symptom: Users lose connectivity when connected through trunk
topology: Switches connected using trunk link
expected_root_cause: Required VLAN is not allowed on trunk
evidence: show interfaces trunk does not list required VLAN
recommended_action: Verify trunk allowed VLAN configuration

symptom: Only one VLAN works across trunk
topology: Two switches connected through trunk
evidence: show interfaces trunk shows missing VLAN
recommended_action: Verify allowed VLAN list

symptom: PC cannot reach remote network
expected_root_cause: Default gateway is outside host subnet
recommended_action: Correct or verify default gateway configuration

symptom: Host can reach local devices but not remote networks
topology: PC has local connectivity but no remote connectivity
evidence: host configuration has no default gateway
recommended_action: Configure correct default gateway

symptom: Multiple hosts cannot reach external network
topology: Hosts use the same incorrect gateway
evidence: gateway differs from router interface subnet
recommended_action: Verify gateway addressing and router interface

symptom: PC receives 169.254.x.x address
topology: DHCP clients connected to access VLAN
expected_root_cause: DHCP server or relay is unreachable
evidence: client receives APIPA address
recommended_action: Verify DHCP server reachability and relay configuration

symptom: Some VLAN clients receive no IP address
topology: Multiple VLANs use centralized DHCP
expected_root_cause: DHCP relay configuration may be missing
evidence: DHCP requests fail from one VLAN
recommended_action: Verify DHCP relay configuration

symptom: Clients receive wrong subnet address
topology: DHCP server serves multiple network pools
evidence: client address does not match VLAN subnet
recommended_action: Verify DHCP pool and VLAN mapping

symptom: DHCP clients intermittently lose addresses
topology: Large number of clients use DHCP
evidence: available DHCP addresses are insufficient
recommended_action: Check DHCP pool utilization

symptom: Users can access servers by IP but not hostname
topology: Clients use centralized DNS
expected_root_cause: DNS configuration or server is unavailable
evidence: IP connectivity works while hostname resolution fails
recommended_action: Verify DNS server configuration and reachability

symptom: Only some domains fail to resolve
topology: Clients use configured DNS server
expected_root_cause: DNS forwarding or DNS records are incomplete
evidence: some names resolve while others fail
recommended_action: Verify DNS server and forwarding configuration

symptom: Internal hostname cannot be resolved
topology: Internal application uses private DNS
evidence: internal hostname lookup fails
recommended_action: Verify internal DNS records

symptom: PC cannot reach server network
topology: Router connects multiple networks
evidence: show ip route does not contain 192.168.30.0/24
recommended_action: Verify routing table and routing configuration

symptom: Remote subnet is unreachable
topology: Router should learn remote network dynamically
evidence: show ip route lacks expected remote network
recommended_action: Verify routing protocol operation

symptom: Traffic reaches router but not destination
topology: Multiple routers exist between source and destination
expected_root_cause: Next-hop or return route is missing
evidence: routing table lacks required path
recommended_action: Verify next-hop and return routing

symptom: Only one direction of communication works
topology: Two routed networks communicate through multiple routers
evidence: route exists in one direction but not reverse direction
recommended_action: Verify routing tables on both routers

symptom: Default route is unavailable
topology: Edge router requires upstream connectivity
evidence: show ip route has no default route
recommended_action: Verify default route configuration

symptom: Users cannot access application server
topology: ACL configured between user and server networks
evidence: show access-lists contains deny entry matching traffic
recommended_action: Review ACL rules and permitted traffic

symptom: Ping works but application traffic fails
topology: ICMP works while TCP application traffic fails
evidence: show access-lists shows deny for application traffic
recommended_action: Verify protocol and port permissions

symptom: Only one subnet is unable to access server
topology: ACL applies to multiple source networks
evidence: ACL contains deny rule for source subnet
recommended_action: Review source-specific ACL entry

symptom: Internal hosts cannot access Internet
topology: Edge router performs NAT
evidence: NAT configuration or translation evidence is missing
recommended_action: Verify NAT inside/outside interfaces and rules

symptom: Some internal hosts can access Internet but others cannot
topology: Multiple internal subnets use NAT
expected_root_cause: NAT rule does not include all source networks
evidence: NAT configuration excludes affected subnet
recommended_action: Verify NAT access list and pool configuration

symptom: Public server is unreachable from Internet
topology: Static NAT configured for internal server
expected_root_cause: Static translation is missing or incorrect
evidence: NAT configuration lacks expected static mapping
recommended_action: Verify static NAT configuration

symptom: Users cannot connect to corporate Wi-Fi
topology: Wireless clients connect through AP infrastructure
evidence: client association/authentication evidence indicates failure
recommended_action: Verify wireless SSID and authentication configuration

symptom: Wi-Fi clients connect but cannot access network
topology: Wireless clients obtain association but no network access
expected_root_cause: VLAN or gateway mapping for wireless clients is incorrect
evidence: wireless clients are associated but network path is unavailable
recommended_action: Verify wireless VLAN and gateway configuration

symptom: Network connection is completely unavailable
topology: Router interface connects to downstream network
evidence: interface is administratively down
recommended_action: Verify interface and enable it if intentionally disabled

symptom: Network connection is unstable
topology: Router interface connects to endpoint
evidence: interface is down and line protocol is down
recommended_action: Inspect interface state and physical connectivity

symptom: Two hosts intermittently lose connectivity
topology: Multiple hosts share the same subnet
evidence: same IP address appears multiple times in evidence
recommended_action: Identify conflicting hosts and correct addressing

symptom: Host cannot communicate with expected subnet
topology: Host configured with IPv4 address and subnet mask
expected_root_cause: Subnet mask is invalid or incorrect
